name: const unsafe fn read_unaligned < T > (src : * const T) -> T
rule: When constructing `src` for an unaligned packed field, creating an intermediate reference with an expression such as `&packed.unaligned as *const FieldType` is undefined behavior, even if the reference is temporary and immediately cast.
api: const unsafe fn read_unaligned < T > (src : * const T) -> T
